objective: Modify pipeline/consumer.py job_timeout to resolve the frozen C1 timeout chain (job['timeout_ms'] → job['timeout'] draft-key fallback → DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 30000) so the consumer sees the producer-set timeout; make tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py::test_pipeline_e2e_effective_timeout pass without changing producer.py, engine.py, or any existing test file.

concepts: job wire format: dict with keys id, payload, timeout_ms
C1 fallback precedence: timeout_ms > timeout > DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (DA-1)
unittest invocation from repo root (python -m unittest)

non_goals: Do not rename or drop 'timeout_ms' in pipeline/producer.py
Do not change engine.run_job logic or comparison semantics (C2 frozen)
Do not edit tests/test_producer.py, tests/test_consumer.py, or tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py
Do not add new dependencies, configuration, or public APIs
Do not add retry/queue/async job features or payload-schema changes
implementation_constraints: Stdlib only — no new imports beyond those consumer.py already has
Keep DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000 and the existing module docstring style
job_timeout must return int milliseconds in every branch (timeout_ms hit, fallback hit, default)
No file changes outside owned_paths; every other repo file is read-only for this task

deliverables.what: job_timeout implementing the C1 resolution chain (timeout_ms → timeout → DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS)

acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_consumer -v → 'Ran 3 tests ... OK', exit code 0 (test_job_timeout_default green)

acceptance_tests.description: consumer.job_timeout({'timeout': 123}) returns 123 — the draft-key fallback required by DA-1 is preserved
If the 'timeout_ms' branch is missing, the e2e test fails with assertEqual(500) receiving 30000 — this distinguishes a resolution-order bug from a default-return bug
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_pipeline_e2e.TestPipelineE2E.test_pipeline_e2e_effective_timeout -v → FAIL with '30000 != 500' when job_timeout still reads only 'timeout'

failure_cases.scenario: job carries only the draft key: {'timeout': 123}

failure_cases.expected_behavior: job_timeout returns 500 — timeout_ms wins per C1 precedence order

handoff.notes: Checkpoint must record: final job_timeout resolution order; confirmation that producer.py, engine.py, and the three existing test files are byte-identical to baseline; any deviation from the C1 chain as a CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST (never an inline key rename).
